hero.headline: Hear what is in your path.
hero.sub: Point your phone ahead. The app warns you by voice about potholes, stairs, poles and vehicles.
hero.factsLine: Works offline · Private by default · English, हिंदी, తెలుగు

howItWorks.label: 01 / How it works
howItWorks.title: Three steps, no setup.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Keep your phone at chest height with the camera facing ahead.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The app looks at the left, centre and right, on your phone.
howItWorks.step3Desc: You hear short warnings, most urgent first, such as "Pothole, left."

privacy.label: 03 / Privacy and safety
privacy.privacyDesc: Your camera stays on your phone. Video is processed on the device. Nothing is recorded or uploaded unless you choose to share a photo to help improve the app.
privacy.safetyDesc: An aid, not a replacement. Keep using your white cane or guide. Do not rely on this app alone to cross roads.
